# email-dns-audit

> Audit a domain's email DNS records over an injected resolver: SPF syntax and the 10-lookup limit per RFC 7208, DMARC policy per RFC 7489 and DKIM selector keys. Go module `github.com/Trysac/u262-email-dns-audit`, package `emaildnsaudit`, standard library only, Go >= 1.23.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example, public API and rule codes
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): package shape, resolver injection and errors
- [Project](docs/PROJECT.md): objective, scope and out-of-scope
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and limits
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): running and covered acceptance cases
- [Stack](docs/STACK.md): tools used and discarded
